name: smwmusic-tower-of-heaven-surpassing-heaven-luna-ascension-remix
title: Tower of Heaven - Surpassing Heaven 🪽 ~ Luna Ascension (Remix)
description:
SPOILERS
❝ I saw the traveler make his way toward the monolith,
That thin gash amidst the clouds;
An open seam between heaven and earth that eluded the Eye of God.
Or perhaps it had not; perhaps it beckoned from one realm
To the other, wedded And ruled as one;
For look how clean it splits the horizon 'twain, absorbs it,
Makes it Strange,
An indomitable beam,
A tower of heaven. ❞
ㅤ- Journal of an unknown traveler, 2009


Did an arrangement of Luna Ascension from Tower of Heaven. Kinda teased a remix from this game a bit back in November, and it's time I finally do this banger!! I love this game and it's soundtrack to death so goddamn much!!

I've been a fan of flashygoodness's works ever since I first heard Luna Ascension in New Super Mario World 1: The Twelve Magic Orbs back in 2016, and every time I listen to ToH's OST or go back to this game, I tear up a bit.

Important:
ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," P-Switch, Yoshi SFX, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. C# Minor w/ slight detune (Remix Pitch)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ1. C# Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. B Minor (Indignant Divinity Pitch)
ㅤ3. C Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Original Echo Delay, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (Intro & OG Echo)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤㅤ♠ Keeps the Intro
ㅤ2. Drastically Decreases Echo Delay (Intro & LOWER Echo)
ㅤㅤ♠ Keeps the Intro
ㅤ3. Decreases Echo Delay (No Intro & LOW Echo)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤㅤ♠ Skips the Intro
